meta.title: Zawmo — Shot from all angles
meta.description: Zawmo is a free app, no download needed: capture your moment, let everyone who was there add their angles, and get a pro video ready to share. Tell your story over time, shot by shot.

home.lead: Every great moment is seen by more than one person. On Zawmo, all your angles meet in one place and become the whole moment.
points: Everyone adds their angle: a photo or a video up to 40 seconds
An automatic montage of every angle, ready to share
Send the link to anyone who was there, no app install needed
home.createHint: Capture it, and let your friends add their angles.
home.usesTitle: What you can do with Zawmo

uses.title: A moment around you
uses.text: A sunset, rain, a cup of coffee, a day out: shoot it, and see who caught the same moment near you.

uses.title: Your story over time
uses.text: Your plant, your house going up, your pregnancy or your child: one photo a week becomes a video that tells the story. Private to you.

uses.title: Your occasion, from every guest
uses.text: A wedding, a graduation, a birthday: one link for the guests, everyone adds their photos, and you get a video from every angle.
